label: native-birth-retained-wal-baseline-v3
scope: Actual retained Native WAL batch and live exports after rename and same-name replacement. Original durable record must retain its write-time backing contract, not whichever same-name collection happens to exist now. Independent Native ACK/data custody and two reopens in both modes. Expected pre-fix failures; no portable authority/main/application qualification. First fixture correctly refused mesh-synchronized rename before reaching the intended assertion. This baseline fixes only the fixture: renameable Standard A, replacement TimeSeries B. Runtime implementation changes remain outside this pinned commit and are not part of baseline. v2 correctly refused a request before the checkpoint retention floor because the fixture had no consumer. v3 declares an actual local-consumer hold from zero, which persists across checkpoints and never counts as a replica ACK. Original payload/contract assertions unchanged.
